subject: finding.AUDIT-GOVERNANCE-STALE
statement: About 15 living lines described settled things as open or proposed (ADR-0003 PROPOSED in five places, done next steps, closed issues). Fixed in docs; guarded by an automated test: lint-docs now flags a living doc that calls an accepted ADR proposed, and checks brain/gates.json.

subject: finding.AUDIT-GOVERNANCE-CONTRADICTIONS
statement: Current decisions contradicted each other or earlier still-valid rules: the adr-0004 record still withdrew M4-M6; business-scope overrode the canon's whole 'not promoted' list, safety items included; M5 scope stated three ways; act-outward based on ADR-0003 instead of permissions_carried NONE; a budget read as execution authority; opt-out learning vs no automatic promotion; two 'live' gates with no running check. Fixed by document review (ADR-0006 consistency amendment and superseding records). Not guarded by an automated test: validate catches only two current decisions on the same subject, not contradictions across subjects.

subject: finding.AUDIT-BRAIN-HARDENING
statement: Reproduced against PR #51 and fixed: a branch record citing an old owner-merged PR showed as current; a supersession chain with a link not in force revived the oldest decision; cycles and self-supersession erased decisions silently; a decision whose replacement could not be checked still showed as confirmed; a duplicate id let a pending copy show as current; non-object JSON lines and non-text fields crashed validate and status; due reviews vanished when GitHub was unreachable; a malformed authority_ref vanished from status; subjects differing only in case escaped the contradiction check; a missing --records folder passed.

subject: finding.AUDIT-PIPEFAIL
statement: The base-branch publication scan piped into tee under the default `bash -e`, so a BLOCK from the enforcing scanner never failed the step (since PR #45). The step now runs with `shell: bash` (pipefail); a test fails any workflow step that pipes into tee without it.

subject: finding.AUDIT-PR-CODE-FIRST
statement: The enforcing checks now run before any PR code and pin the base commit SHA from the event: the base-copy publication scan, and a new base-copy Brain validation (brain-records previously ran only the PR's own brain/ code).

subject: finding.AUDIT-WORKFLOW-EDIT
statement: Required checks run from the PR's own workflow files (pull_request event), so a PR that edits or adds workflows can make them pass. The control today is owner-only merges and reading the diff; a pull_request_target design or a recorded review for workflow changes needs an owner decision.

subject: finding.AUDIT-DETECTION-GAPS
